content: Hi! Can you walk me through your approach to designing a test automation framework from scratch?

Sure. I usually start by selecting the right tools based on the tech stack. For a modern web app, I'd choose Playwright with TypeScript. I use the Page Object Model design pattern to keep the code maintainable, and integrate the tests into GitHub Actions for CI/CD.
How do you handle test data management and flaky tests?

For test data, I prefer generating it dynamically via API before the test starts and cleaning it up after. To handle flakiness, I avoid hardcoded sleeps and use dynamic waits provided by Playwright. If a test is consistently flaky, I quarantine it until the root cause is fixed.
